title: Known-object test, TOI-3240.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-3240.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, not recovered, partial, recovered (27 covered epochs). Residual screen: 72 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 4 light curve(s), forming 32 distinct event(s), 4 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460094.6319 (ΔT 49.62 d); 0 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
